meta_data.base_class: Find the current price for a specific game on <a specific gaming platform>. This is a general tool that uses the `platform` parameter. Subclass tools will be hardcoded to a specific platform (e.g., Steam, Xbox Store) and will remove the `platform` parameter.

tool_template.name: find_<class>_game_price
tool_template.description: Find the current price for a specific game on <class> platform.

game.description: The name of the game on the <class> platform.

currency.description: The currency in which the price should be displayed for the game on the <class> platform. Example values: 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'.

region.description: The region or country for which the game price should be retrieved on the <class> platform. Example values: 'US', 'EU', 'JP'.

discount.description: Flag to indicate whether to include current discounts in the price calculation for the game on the <class> platform.

language.description: The language in which the game price information should be displayed on the <class> platform. Example values: 'en', 'fr', 'de'.
